grants.description: Verify your identity and provide your National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your appeal to the correct benefit decision

grants.description: Share your appeal and supporting evidence with DWP (the respondent)
grants.purpose: DWP must receive your appeal so they can respond and explain their decision. This is required for a fair hearing.

grants.description: Share medical or specialist evidence with the tribunal and DWP
grants.purpose: The tribunal needs evidence to understand your condition or circumstances and make a fair decision

grants.description: Grant access to your appointed representative (if you choose to have one)
grants.purpose: Your representative can act on your behalf, respond to letters, and receive all information about your appeal

grants.description: Request and receive an audio recording of your tribunal hearing
grants.purpose: You can request an audio recording of your hearing within 18 months for your records

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMCTS Benefit Appeals in writing or via your online account to withdraw your appeal
revocation.effect: Appeal will be withdrawn. Tribunal will close the case. You may be able to submit a new appeal if still within time limits.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot submit the final appeal without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot appoint or change your representative without your confirmation. Agent cannot attend the tribunal hearing on your behalf - you or your appointed representative must attend. Agent cannot withdraw your appeal without your explicit instruction. Agent cannot request set-aside or Upper Tribunal appeal without your explicit instruction.
